_about: Public-domain Archibald Campbell (died 1744), nonjuring Scottish bishop, for the Word Hoard: The Doctrines of a Middle State between Death and the Resurrection (1721), the enlarged and signed edition of his anonymous Some Primitive Doctrines Reviv'd (1713), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 41 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
